senses.gloss:
फट mfn. subst. (-टः-टा-टं) The expanded hood or neck of the Cobra
de capello.
 mf. (-टः-टा)
 1. A tooth.
 2. A cheat.
 E. स्फुट् to burst or
expand, aff. अच् fem. aff. टाप्, deriv. irr.

फट् Ind. Exclamation of no meaning, forming part of a Mantra or in-
cantation.
 E. स्फुट् to burst, aff. क्विप्, and the deriv. irr.
फाट् Ind. An interjection of calling.
